verdict.rationale: Canny is a feedback and roadmapping product, so rescheduling initiatives and moving them between releases is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document this capability. It only shows querying the roadmap and moving ideas through workflow statuses via MCP, which is an adjacent status-update feature, not rescheduling or release reassignment.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reschedule initiatives and move them between releases as priorities change
